commits.message: set initial_tag so the first release bumps to v0.1.0
commits.body:
git-cliff --bumped-version produced '0.1.0' (no prefix) on a repo with no
tags, which fails validation against tag_pattern 'v[0-9]*' and broke the
release workflow. [bump] initial_tag pins the first version with the prefix.

commits.message: add git-cliff changelog and release workflows
commits.body:
- changelog.yml regenerates CHANGELOG.md and docs/changelog.json on push to dev
- release.yml bumps version from conventional commits on push to main, tags,
  publishes a GitHub Release, and fast-forwards dev to main
- cliff.toml: conventional-commits config, repo URLs point to 4drian0rtiz/SuperList
